items.title: Sudan: Trauma Healing Workshop Supports 41 Sudanese Refugee Women and Youth in Uganda
items.description: [Darfur Network for Human Rights] A trauma healing and psychosocial support training reached 41 Sudanese women and youth on 3-4 August 2026. Organizers delivered the training across two groups: 20 participants on the first day and 21 on the second. All were survivors directly affected by the war in Sudan, now living as refugees in Uganda. Most came from Darfur and South Kordofan, regions heavily affected by the ongoing conflict.
items.titleIt: Sudan: Trauma Healing Workshop Supports 41 Sudanese Refugee Women and Youth in Uganda
